authority.approval: APPROVED 2026-09-28 by the user (repository owner), in the Claude Code session: one bounded three-seed comparison of btt_policy_obs_v3_geo4 against the matched M7n v3 controls, after final registration and verification (frozen manifest, profiles and rule; all-three-seed control compatibility on the final code; the M7n 10/11 unit result resolved; the offline sample and measurement procedure pinned). No further approval between preparation, passing preflight and launch. Stop after the registered three-seed decision. Original v3 stays selected until the registered comparison decides otherwise.
authority.approval_record: the user's message of 2026-09-28 (quoted in docs/rl_geometry_scale_m7p_handoff.md); no separate approval file

question: Does scaling only the segment_geometry block of the v3 observation by 1/4 (btt_policy_obs_v3_geo4) let PPO learn more Mario Break the Targets from normal tick-0 starts than v3 at the same budget: a native-verified clear, a replay-verified qualified crossing or left-target break, or more targets per episode in every seed?
only_difference: contracts.observation: btt_policy_obs_v3_geo4 instead of btt_policy_obs_v3_entities (segment_geometry length columns / 8,000 instead of / 2,000 and velocity columns / 200 instead of / 50; every other key, flag, the network, PPO, reward v2, Track 1, the lifecycle and the budget identical); compatibility views differ only in contracts.observation

arms.ctl: runs/m7n/campaign/m7n_s{0,1,2}_v3 (the M7n v3 runs), reused only while the R1 reproduction and the record verification pass

sequencing: strictly sequential, one run at a time, s0, s1, s2; the launch gate before each

observation.only_difference: segment_geometry block scaled by 1/4 (lengths / 8,000, velocities / 200); every other key, flag and rule identical; each checkpoint evaluated under its own contract

reward.both_arms: btt_reward_v2 (frozen values); no exploration credit, no curriculum

launch_gate.readings: a failed reading is re-measured after 60 s, at most 5 readings

registered_settings.monitor: m7d Monitor: hard alerts stop the run (a row violating its btt_reward_v2 closed form, more than 10 game processes or listeners in two samples, a changed user config, low disk)
stop_conditions: a failed control check or record verification
registered_settings.after_a_stop: the campaign stops and reports; a stopped run is moved to _partial and preserved; nothing is fixed or relaunched by this driver
registered_settings.evaluation: post hoc, frozen parameters, tick-0 starts only (the M7n protocol), btt_eval_metrics_v1, the checkpoint's own observation contract, clear verification, crossing verification (btt_qualified_crossing_v1), census
registered_settings.measurement: offline supporting diagnostics after evaluation (measurement_plan); read only; never gating
registered_settings.training_inputs: tick-0 episodes of the run itself only; never fixtures, TAS, traces, recordings, the diagnostic checkpoint, other runs
registered_settings.initialisation: fresh models only: ckpt_000000000 must equal the fresh construction AND the M7n run's initial set of the seed; nothing loaded from the geo4 diagnostic
registered_settings.never: native RNG state is never inspected, logged, validated, controlled, compared or hashed

diagnostic.never_reused: no campaign run loads the diagnostic's checkpoint, optimizer state or statistics; every run starts from the fresh construction

measurement_plan.purpose: supporting diagnostics only; never gating; never used to select checkpoints or alter training

sample.population_A: the two M7n final-episode traces (policy play; 6,578 states)
sample.population_B: eight action-hold-probe k = 1 episodes (random play; 27,419 states)
sample.rebuild: exact 606-value inputs rebuilt from the raw replies under EACH arm's own contract (v3 for the control, geo4 for the experimental arm); nothing scaled is fed to the other arm's network

measurements: actor and critic layer 1: sat95 (abs tanh > 0.95), sat99, mean derivative 1 - h^2, units saturated in > 90 % of states, of which stuck at one sign, two-sided, effectively constant (std < 0.05); on the whole sample and separately on populations A and B; layer 2 sat95

recorded pairs (identical indices in both arms): target break pairs (43) vs consecutive no-break controls (3,000): median abs dV, median KL, hidden distances; up-B early-vs-late (587) vs early-vs-early controls (800); jump-squat tic 0 vs 2 (140) vs tic 0 vs 0 (174)
block ablation KL: agent, targets, segment_geometry zeroed
policy entropy on the sample; first-layer weight norms; per-interval weight-row change
measurement_plan.procedure: rl/m7p_measure.py (the functions of rl/m7p_geo4_diag.py) after training and evaluation are verified; read only
measurement_plan.reading: a persisting saturation reduction with retained margins is reported as such; it is not a success and selects nothing

status.required: a PASSED R1 record on code.control_check_sha256 and executable.sha256 AND a PASSED record verification on this rule; otherwise train is blocked; replacement controls are never trained by this driver

control.procedure: rl/m7p_control_check.py (R1: 3 x 102,400 fresh M7n-profile runs vs the M7n ckpt_000102400 digests and rows) + rl/m7p_control_verify.py (identity, evaluation verifiers, clear / crossing candidates, rule inputs vs the M7n analysis); rerun whenever the control-check fingerprint, the executable or the rule changes

evaluation_protocol.crossing_verification: rl/m7n_crossing.verify_crossings_in (btt_qualified_crossing_v1) on the experimental finals; the control's M7n documents re-verified by crossing_inputs
evaluation_protocol.own_contract: every checkpoint is evaluated under the observation contract recorded in its checkpoint.json (geo4 for the experimental arm); the evaluator refuses any other
evaluation_protocol.inputs: rl/m7l_analysis.label_inputs on both arms' finals and the experimental initials; rl/m7n_crossing.crossing_inputs

not_evidence_of_success: lower saturation, higher derivative or retained sensitivity (supporting diagnostics only)
a higher target mean in one or two seeds (gate 4 needs every seed)
a raw left entry, an off-stage fall on the left, an unqualified crossing
training-time tracker counts or native clears during training (training behaviour, always reported separately)
the geo4 diagnostic's 60-episode result (one seed, 307,200 transitions, stop-only band)
selection: geo4 is selected only by gates 1, 2 or 4; every other outcome (invalid, incomplete, failure_regression, failure_no_learning, inconclusive) keeps btt_policy_obs_v3_entities selected. Lower first-layer saturation, retained sensitivity or any other offline measurement is reported as a supporting diagnostic and is NEVER sufficient to select geo4.
